mapper.insert: INSERT INTO resource(user_id, title, description, file_url, file_type, file_size, upload_type, batch_no, folder_name, relative_path) VALUES(#{userId}, #{title}, #{description}, #{fileUrl}, #{fileType}, #{fileSize}, #{uploadType}, #{batchNo}, #{folderName}, #{relativePath})
mapper.select:
SELECT r.id, r.title, r.description, r.file_type, r.file_size, r.download_count, r.upload_type, r.folder_name, r.relative_path, r.batch_no, r.create_time, u.nickname AS uploaderName FROM resource r LEFT JOIN user u ON r.user_id = u.id
AND r.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')
AND r.file_type = #{fileType}
ORDER BY r.create_time DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE resource SET download_count = download_count + 1 WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT DATE(create_time) AS date, COUNT(*) AS count FROM resource WHERE create_time >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL #{days} - 1 DAY) GROUP BY DATE(create_time) ORDER BY date
SELECT LOWER(file_type) AS fileType, COUNT(*) AS count FROM resource GROUP BY LOWER(file_type) ORDER BY count DESC
SELECT id, title, download_count AS downloadCount, file_type AS fileType FROM resource ORDER BY download_count DESC, create_time DESC LIMIT #{limit}
